resources.string: Waiting for ECR on TCP port %1$d
Cannot listen on TCP port %1$d. Check the ECR configuration.
Unable to save the ECR result. Reconciliation required.
USB and RS232 are reserved for the next phase. Use TCP/IP for this version.
To unlock, press Clear 10 times consecutively, or tap the ECR screen 10 times on a device without a keypad. The configuration password is required. Kiosk mode returns after 1 minute of inactivity.
